rationale: The stock gapped down ~7.5% on earnings beat news (paradoxical reaction), has since recovered significantly from the session low of $148.17 to $160.94, placing it at 76.6% of today's range — meaning most of the bounce has already occurred. The price is below the 9-EMA ($162.49) and the broad market is under pressure (SPY -1.52%, VIXY +8.76%), creating conflicting signals: the intraday recovery momentum argues long but the macro environment and position in range argue against chasing. With no clear mechanical edge in either direction at this moment, skipping is the prudent choice.
